summary: The registrant, 21Shares Polkadot Staking ETF, filed an 8-K on August 26, 2026, reporting entry into a Benchmark Licensing Agreement with FTSE International Limited and an amendment to the Sponsor Agreement. The licensing agreement replaces the prior benchmark provider (CF Benchmarks) effective August 27, 2026, for calculating net asset value; the sponsor fee timing changes from weekly to at least quarterly payment in DOT. These are routine operational and administrative updates for an ETF, not a special situation.
